The coffee corner is my favorite place. The coffee corner is not far from my home. Owen wants to visit Sydney. What's more, my bag hangs over one shoulder.
Owen usually eats soup for lunch. My friend Amy is very kind. We talk about English a lot. What's more, he was fired for being late again.
Amy likes soup too. We often go to the cinema together. After school, we play together.
